Darkjuan Logic Games (Coolbeanman)

Live

Solo developer

Free browser brain games for ages 10–16, with progress saved in the browser and optional donations.

A set of free logic and brain games aimed at kids and teens. Built as a Vite 6 + React 19 + TypeScript single-page app, with a small PHP endpoint for donations through Square and progress stored in the browser. Hosted on Hostinger.

Stack

  • Vite 6
  • React 19
  • TypeScript
  • PHP
  • Square
